ranking_policy.rule: Only existing PICK decisions are ranked. Order by confidence tier HIGH > MODERATE > LEAN, then probability edge descending, expected value descending, model conditional win probability descending, then stable opportunity id.

near_miss_policy.rule: PASS findings may appear on a watchlist only when model conditional win probability is at least 0.52 and either probability edge is at least 0.02 or expected value is at least 0.01. A watchlist item remains PASS and can never be promoted by Step 17.

explanation_policy.rule: Explain the model-market disagreement using already-generated football projections, distributions, market lines, and prices. Do not invent causal football claims that are not present in model inputs.

locked_rules: Step 17 cannot create a PICK. It can only rank PICK decisions already emitted by Steps 15 and 16.
Step 17 cannot modify model projections, probability distributions, fair-market probabilities, EV, recommendation thresholds, or confidence labels.
Weekly game markets and weekly player props may share one slate ranking because their probability edge and EV use the same locked downstream market framework.
Season-long player props are not mixed into the weekly slate ranking.
No weighted composite opportunity score is permitted; ranking is lexicographic and transparent.
PASS findings stay PASS. Near-miss watchlist status is descriptive only.
Market movement may change a downstream PICK or PASS only in Steps 15 or 16; Step 17 merely reflects the latest eligible recommendation.
Sportsbook information remains downstream and cannot mutate football projections or distributions.
Missing markets or missing distributions are represented as unavailable rather than synthesized.
The engine cannot place wagers, size stakes, or make bankroll decisions.
